title: Getting started
subtitle: Three steps to add sh-ui to an existing project. The flow is the same for React and Flutter.
intro: Starting from a brand-new Next.js project? The create project page lets you run npx sh-ui-cli create with a template that ships FSD structure, sh-ui config, and plugins (Sentry, next-intl) pre-wired. This page covers the manual flow for an existing project.

step1.heading: 1. Create a config file
step1.after: An interactive prompt picks platform (react/flutter), base (neutral/zinc/slate), radius, and mode, then writes sh-ui.config.json.

step2.heading: 2. Install tokens + base reset
step2.after: Token files are generated with your config values baked in. React gets CSS variables (tokens.css) and base.css; Flutter gets Dart constants (sh_ui_tokens.dart).
step2.note: base.css sets box-sizing, overflow, min-width and other safeguards that prevent common mobile layout accidents (e.g. a child's min-content pushing the viewport and creating horizontal scroll). Import it right after tokens.css.

step3.heading: 3. Install components
step3.after: The component source is copied into paths.components. From that point on, the code is yours — modify it freely.

react.heading: React
react.globalImport: Importing tokens.css in your global CSS exposes every token globally — --background, --primary, --space-*, --text-*, and the rest.
react.darkMode: Setting mode: "light-dark" defines the light defaults on :root and the dark variants under the .dark class. Switching is just toggling <html className="dark">.

flutter.heading: Flutter
flutter.materialApp: Plugging ShUiTheme into ThemeData.extensions lets every descendant widget reach tokens via Theme.of(context).extension<ShUiTheme>().
flutter.tokensInWidget: The convention is to pull shUi out in one line.
flutter.darkToggle: Toggle via themeMode: ThemeMode.light / .dark / .system. Each branch uses ShUiTheme.light or ShUiTheme.dark respectively.
flutter.safeArea: Keep content out of system UI zones — iPhone notch / Dynamic Island, Android gesture indicator, etc. — by handling it at the screen-template level. Scaffold + AppBar absorbs the top status bar automatically, but when you draw a full-screen background or skip AppBar, wrap with SafeArea.
flutter.responsive: Combine shUi.breakpoint.sm/md/lg/xl tokens with MediaQuery or LayoutBuilder to branch layouts by viewport width. sh-ui's ShUiSidebar.mode: auto uses the same pattern internally.
